Vision Government Solutions

|

SOMERS,CT

|

Welcome

Welcome to the Vision Government Solutions Assessment
Record database for the Town of Somers.

As mandated by Connecticut State Law, the Town of Somers
and Vision Government Solutions have completed a revaluation of all real
property for the Grand List of October 1, 2025.

The
information provided in this database reflects the new assessed values for each
real estate parcel in the Town of Somers as of the assessment date, October 1,
2025. The previous assessments were as of October 1, 2020.

Notices have been sent out to property owners informing
them of their new assessments. The new assessment represents 70% of the fair
market value of your property as of October 1, 2025.

Property Owners are cautioned NOT to apply
the current tax (mill) rate to your new assessment. Doing so will result in an
inaccurate calculation of future tax liability. The new tax (mill) rate will
not be set by the Board of Finance until after the budget has been approved in
the Spring of 2026.

The Somers Assessor’s Office and Vision Government
Solutions would like to thank the residents and property owners for their
cooperation throughout the 2025 Revaluation project.

(c) 2026 Vision Government Solutions, Inc. All rights reserved.
